verdict.rationale: incident.io documents private Status Pages, plus Workflows that automatically publish to a status page when an incident is updated. That gives stakeholders a structured update channel outside the incident channel, and AI suggestions help draft those updates. The evidence never documents a subscription mechanism for internal stakeholders, and private pages are only named, not described. missing for 10: documented stakeholder subscription (email/notification opt-in) to incident updates, details on private/internal status page audiences, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, internal stakeholders get structured incident updates they can subscribe to, without joining the war room

citations.quote: We've built an easy and delightful way to communicate with customers during an incident with our public and private Status Pages.
With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
